description: This file defines the VoiceWakeRuntime actor responsible for managing the voice wake speech recognition pipeline in a macOS app. It handles starting/stopping recognition, processing audio inputs, managing state transitions, and interacting with UI overlays and other components for voice trigger detection and capture.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing the voice wake recognition lifecycle, including starting/stopping recognition, handling audio input, managing detection states, and coordinating overlays and voice capture processes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the recognition state based on application state, starting or stopping recognition as appropriate.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition session with specified configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current recognition session and releases related resources.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Sets up the speech recognizer with the locale specified in configuration.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updating overlays, and triggering capture on matches or fallback conditions.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and match details for debugging.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs the RMS audio level of audio taps.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs callbacks from recognition with empty transcripts.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check to pause recognition if only trigger words are detected with no further speech.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a silence detection check to fallback on recognition if no speech is detected within a window.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Executes the pause check after the specified delay and conditions.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines if the transcript matches only trigger words and no additional speech.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Performs a fallback detection based on silence if no speech is recognized.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts voice capture to record commands after trigger detection, or activates push-to-talk mode.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors and manages the capture session, finalizing after silence or timeout.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends the capture session, processes the final transcript, updates the UI, and forwards the command.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates noise floor estimation and UI levels based on RMS audio input.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the speech recognition pipeline for subsequent triggers.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Conditionally restarts recognition if not capturing and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a delayed restart of recognition pipeline.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears the scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Enforces a cooldown period after push-to-talk to prevent immediate retriggering.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition to activate push-to-talk mode.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks that speech was heard beyond the initial trigger word.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts the command text after trigger words.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Gets the command segment after trigger, considering trigger end time if provided.
